A little about me

Curious about people. Intentional about products.

I’m a Product Management professional with experience supporting early-stage fintech development and conducting independent product research.

At Fundform Capital, I contributed to requirements, user stories, feature prioritisation and sprint planning, and served as Scrum Master while collaborating with designers and developers.

My independent ASOS case study reflects how I approach research, validate assumptions and explore practical improvements to user experience.

My background goes beyond tech. I studied Biochemistry and have experience in laboratory operations and virtual assistance. I've worked on everything from managing inventory and supporting daily operations to coordinating schedules, tasks, and remote teams. These experiences have given me an understanding of how different workplaces and teams operate.

How I approach product decisions

01 · Desirability

Is this solving a meaningful problem for real people?

02 · Feasibility

03 · Viability

Does it create sustainable value for the business?
